title: Nuevo Laredo's IMPACTA reached 587 young people and families with mental-health support in a week
excerpt: In the first week of November, 587 people in Nuevo Laredo received psychological care, guidance and prevention activities through the municipal government's IMPACTA institute, which works with students and families on emotional well-being.
content:
In the first week of November, 587 people received psychological attention, guidance and took part in prevention activities run by the Nuevo Laredo municipal government through IMPACTA, the Municipal Institute for the Prevention of Addictions, Antisocial Behavior and Trends, according to Desde Donde Estamos. The effort aims to strengthen young people's emotional well-being and give families tools to support them.

Talks called “Gestionando mis emociones” were held at Bachillerato Nacional Margarita Maza and CBTis 234, where students reflected on recognizing, understanding and regulating their emotions and picked up tools for facing everyday challenges in a healthy way, according to the report.

Through the “IMPACTA en tu Escuela” program, free one-on-one psychological care was provided to students at COBAT 18 and COBAT Plantel 23 “El Bayito,” bringing professional support to students who need help with emotional and personal situations.

Parents and guardians were also reached through the “Tu Voz IMPACTA” brigades and the “Presidencia Cerquita de Ti” outreach days, where families could ask questions about their children's school situations, learn about available support and connect with school psychology services, specialized care and family therapy.

IMPACTA's support channels remain open for anyone seeking mental-health guidance. For situations needing immediate attention, the Línea de la Vida is available free of charge at 800 911 2000, 24 hours a day, 365 days a year. IMPACTA's offices are at Belden #1200 in Colonia Victoria, and information is also available through the “Impacta NLD” Facebook page.

Source: Desde Donde Estamos, November 11, 2026.
